jina: Provisions relating to offices established by this Constitution
maudhui: (1) Any person holding an office established by this Constitution, including the office of Minister, Deputy Minister or Member of Parliament other than an ex officio Member, may resign by notice in writing signed by him, subject to the following: (a) if appointed or elected by one person, the notice shall be submitted to that person; if appointed or elected by a body of persons, it shall be submitted to that body; (b) if the person is the President, the notice shall be submitted to the Speaker; (c) if the person is the Speaker or Deputy Speaker, the notice shall be submitted to Parliament; and (d) if the person is a Member of Parliament, the notice shall be submitted to the Speaker. (2) A person who gives notice of resignation under subarticle (1) shall be deemed to have resigned from the date the notice is received by the relevant person or body, or by a person authorized to receive it, unless the notice specifies a later date, in which case resignation shall take effect on that later date. (3) Where a person holding an office established by this Constitution resigns, he may, if otherwise qualified and eligible, be appointed or elected again to that office in accordance with this Constitution. (4) Subarticle (3) shall not prevent a person who is President from being re-elected President while still holding the office of President.
